statement.text:
Let F be a local subformation of some formation X of finite groups and let Ω
be the set of all maximal homogeneous X-screens of F. Find a way of constructing
the elements of Ω with the help of the maximal inner local screen of F. What can be
said about the cardinality of Ω? For definitions see (L. A. Shemetkov, Formations of
finite groups, Moscow, Nauka, 1978 (Russian)).                       L. A. Shemetkov
